title: His father and the five drumming Giles brothers
summary: His father Albert Giles Sr. died when he was about five, after setting up his drums for him; the five brothers (Clay, Oscar, Olivier, Major, Albert) were all drummers from Thibodaux.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Can you tell us about your father then? My father was named Albert Giles. He was senior and you're junior. Junior. My daddy died when I was around five years old. Do you remember how old he was about then?
He was in his late 30s when he died. Wasn't very old at all. No he was not.

He was a very young man. And I remember he set his drum up once for me. That's one of the things I can never forget that he set the drums up but I was very young. There's not too much I could do. And after he died well I still didn't lose interest because it must have been in me. Because my uncles all they were drummers. The whole family of the brothers was five of them drummers.
All five? That's right. What were their names? I remember the name Clay Giles.
Clay Giles. Oscar Giles. Olivier Giles. And Major Giles. And Albert Giles.
Every one were drummers? All of them was drummers. They all live up in Thibodeau?
Oh that's their home. Thibodeau was their home. They all lived in Thibodeau.
